entries.name: WHATNOT_ACCESS_TOKEN
entries.description: A Whatnot seller API token, sent as a bearer token to list the seller's orders, order items, products and variants. Create it with only the read:orders and read:inventory scopes; the connector only ever sends GET requests.
howToGet: The seller's account owner (only the owner can create tokens) opens the Personal access tokens tab of Whatnot's developer dashboard and creates a token named KaratOS.
Give it exactly two permissions: read:orders and read:inventory. Don't add any write permission, or read:customers: the connector keeps no buyer details.
Pick an expiration (90 days is the longest fixed choice) and put a reminder in to regenerate it before then.
Whatnot shows the token, which starts wn_pat_tk_, only once: copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
